reasoning_summary: Deterministic verdict is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks, so ACCEPT is not allowed and REJECT is not justified.

R0 statistics and averaging are well converged. Drag statistical uncertainty is 0.0001664 and Strouhal statistical uncertainty is 0.0001267. There are 12 stationary cycles. These are far below the 0.03 tolerance.
Mesh, time and domain components are all unmeasured for both quantities, so no combined uncertainty exists.

Time discretisation is the weakest point of R0. The scheme is first-order Euler at dt = 0.04 D/U, and max Courant is 2.9248 with 2 outer correctors. The Courant check is INCONCLUSIVE because temporal accuracy is unproven without time-step refinement.

R0 has 157.74 steps per shedding period. Euler numerical dissipation at this Courant number could shift the shedding frequency and mean drag, so a time error above the 0.5*tolerance budget is plausible.
REDUCE_TIME_STEP isolates the time error on the identical mesh. REFINE_MESH could change dt automatically and confound mesh and time effects.
Domain truncation looks less likely to dominate. R0 has blockage 0.0125, upstream 30 D, downstream 50 D and half-height 40 D. It is still unmeasured.
The cost is about 1126 s, roughly 1.07x the root run. The budget is 0 of 6 experiments and 0 of 12x compute used, so it is affordable.

hypotheses.hypothesis: First-order Euler time stepping at max Courant 2.92 (dt = 0.04 D/U) biases Strouhal number and/or mean drag by more than 0.5*tolerance (1.5 %).
hypotheses.test: Run R0 with dt divided by 2. If St and Cd each change by less than about 0.5 % relative, the time error is acceptable. If either changes by more than 1.5 %, the time component fails and a further reduction is needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mesh resolution (0.457 D representative cell size, 1.02 D last wake cell) contributes more than 1.5 % error to Cd or St.
hypotheses.test: REFINE_MESH from R0 after the time step is settled. Compare Cd and St against R0.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lateral symmetry-plane boundaries at 40 D and the 50 D outlet bias Cd or St by more than 1.5 %.
hypotheses.test: EXPAND_DOMAIN from R0 with factor 2 and compare Cd and St.

next_experiment.reason: Time error is entirely unmeasured. R0 uses first-order Euler at max Courant 2.92, which is the most likely source of a flaw larger than the tolerance. Halving dt on the same mesh isolates this error without confounding by mesh changes, at a cost of about 1126 s.
next_experiment.expected_outcome: If Cd and St change by less than about 0.5 % relative to R0 (Cd 1.2901, St 0.15849), the time component passes. A change above 1.5 % shows temporal error dominates and calls for a further dt reduction. A change above 3 % beyond noise would be a demonstrated FAIL.
